headlines.title: 央行护航月末资金面，流动性或将平稳跨月
headlines.summary: 月末资金面再度成为债市关注焦点。近期大行资金融出规模边际下降，带动短端资金利率有所上行。不过，央行已提前公告将在月末及8月初开展隔夜逆回购操作，释放维护短端流动性平稳的信号。多家机构认为，7月并非季末月，政府债净缴款压力明显下降，叠加央行隔夜逆回购投放安排，资金面大幅收紧的可能性不大。短期来看，流动性有望平稳跨月，但资金面对债市进一步突破的助力或相对有限，后续仍需关注央行投放力度、银行资金融出变化及8月政府债供给扰动。（上证报）

headlines.title_en: PBOC shields end-of-month liquidity; cash likely to flow smoothly across month
headlines.summary_en: Month-end liquidity conditions are again a focus for the bond market. Recently, large banks' net fund supply has marginally declined, pushing up short-end money rates. However, the PBOC has pre-announced overnight reverse repo operations for late July and early August, signaling efforts to maintain stable short-term liquidity. Many institutions believe July is not a quarter-end month, net government bond settlement pressure has dropped significantly, and with the PBOC's overnight reverse repo arrangements, a sharp liquidity squeeze is unlikely. Short-term liquidity is expected to cross the month smoothly, but liquidity's boost for further bond market breakthroughs may be limited. Follow-up attention is needed on the PBOC's operations, changes in bank fund supply, and August government bond supply disruptions. (Shanghai Securities News)

headlines.title: 业内人士：多重因素扰动，金价短期走势或以震荡为主
headlines.summary: 自6月下旬以来，伦敦现货黄金价格在4000美元/盎司附近反复拉锯。与之形成鲜明反差的是，7月以来A股黄金股率先“躁动”，部分龙头黄金股涨幅超过30%，明显跑赢同期金价。业内人士认为，当前金价中长期支撑逻辑并未发生根本改变，央行购金仍可能推动金价中枢逐步上移，黄金类资产依旧具备配置价值。但短期来看，市场仍面临全球流动性、美联储政策预期、地缘局势以及市场资金流向等多重因素扰动，或以震荡走势为主。（中证报）

headlines.title_en: Insiders: multiple factors disrupt, gold prices to oscillate in short term
headlines.summary_en: Since late June, spot gold in London has repeatedly fluctuated around $4,000 per ounce. In stark contrast, A-share gold stocks have surged since July, with some leading names gaining over 30%, significantly outperforming gold prices. Industry insiders believe the medium-to-long-term support for gold prices hasn't fundamentally changed. Central bank gold purchases may still push the price center higher, making gold assets still worth allocating. But in the short term, the market faces multiple disturbances from global liquidity, Fed policy expectations, geopolitical tensions, and fund flows, likely leading to range-bound trading. (China Securities Journal)

headlines.title: “翻倍基”数量锐减 绩优基金之间差距拉开
headlines.summary: 截至7月28日，年内收益率超过100%的基金仅剩6只，较6月末的246只减少240只。不足一个月，上半年批量涌现的“翻倍基”数量缩水97.56%。“翻倍基”阵营快速缩水的背后，是前期领涨的科技板块遭遇集体调整。7月以来，创业板50指数、科创50指数分别下跌23.16%、23.97%，市场由单边上涨转向高位震荡，重仓人工智能、半导体、通信等方向的基金首当其冲。值得注意的是，剧烈波动也进一步拉开了绩优基金之间的差距。部分基金因持仓高度集中而大幅回吐收益，还有部分基金凭借提前降低仓位、调整持仓结构，继续守在“翻倍线”之上。

headlines.title_en: Number of 'double-base funds' plunges, gap widens among top performers
headlines.summary_en: As of July 28, only six funds had year-to-date returns exceeding 100%, down 240 from 246 at end-June. In less than a month, the number of 'doubling funds' that emerged in H1 has shrunk by 97.56%. This sharp decline is due to collective corrections in previously leading tech sectors. Since July, the ChiNext 50 index and STAR 50 index have fallen 23.16% and 23.97% respectively, as markets shifted from one-way rally to high-level volatility. Funds heavily weighted in AI, semiconductors, and communications were hit hardest. Notably, the volatility has widened the gap among top-performing funds. Some funds with concentrated holdings have seen sharp profit erosion, while others that reduced positions early or adjusted holdings remain above the 'doubling line'.

headlines.title_en: 30-year US Treasury yield rises 11 bps past 5.2%, 2-year TIPS yield drops over 10 bps; Warsh comments on real yields
headlines.summary_en: Wednesday (July 29) New York afternoon, US 10-year Treasury yield rose 7.10 bps to 4.6773%, trading range 4.6042%-4.6956%. Yield hit session low of 4.6042% at 02:00 Beijing time when Fed announced it would hold steady (only a brief, minor decline overall). Yield reached session high at 04:16 after Fed Chair Waller's press conference, approaching July 24 high of 4.7117%, January 14, 2025 high of 4.8069%, and October 23, 2023 high of 5.0187%. Two-year Treasury yield fell 1.44 bps to 4.2726%, trading range 4.3345%-4.2150%, plunged to near 4.24% on rate decision release, and quickly hit session low after Waller's press conference

headlines.title: 证券时报：产业链韧性是A股市场坚固护城河
headlines.summary: 文章称，7月以来，海外市场大幅调整，受输入性因素叠加影响，A股市场也出现起伏。近期一则“国产光刻机研发突破”的传闻，不仅导致阿斯麦股价走低，也引发了A股相关板块逆势上涨。尽管传闻难辨真假，不过市场表现已经表明：产业链的自主可控使得A股受外部影响减少，助力A股形成坚固的护城河。我国拥有全球最完备的工业体系、海量的工程师队伍与规模庞大的终端需求，部分行业的国产替代正从单点突破走向全链条协同。当下最重要的任务之一，就是要不断完善我国的产业链。产业链的完善，将不断增厚上市公司长期成长价值，构筑起抵御外部风险的护城河。当然，对于投资者而言，对市场定价“产业链安全”

headlines.title_en: Securities Times: supply chain resilience is A-share market's solid moat
headlines.summary_en: The article states that since July, overseas markets have seen sharp adjustments, driving volatility in A-shares due to spillover effects. A recent rumor about a breakthrough in domestic lithography machine R&D not only pushed ASML's stock lower but also sparked a counter-trend rally in related A-share sectors. Though the rumor is hard to verify, market performance shows: self-reliance in the supply chain makes A-shares less susceptible to external impacts, helping build a solid moat. China has the world's most complete industrial system, a vast engineer workforce, and massive end-user demand. Domestic substitution in some industries is progressing from isolated breakthroughs to full-chain coordination. One of the most important tasks now is to continuously improve China's industrial chain. A stronger industrial chain will continuously enhance the long-term growth value of listed companies, building a moat against external risks. headlines.title: 7月以来共有25股获5家及以上机构评级，盈利高增长个股获机构扎堆关注
headlines.summary: 据统计，截至7月29日，7月以来44家机构累计发布936次“买入型”（包括买入、增持、推荐、强烈推荐、强烈买入）评级，合计覆盖546股。 从个股来看，7月以来，共有25股获5家及以上机构评级，其中贵州茅台、宁德时代、中国人寿、恒瑞医药获机构评级数量居前，分别有17家、16家、11家、10家。 从业绩上来看，盈利高增长个股获机构扎堆关注。上述25股中，有19股发布了半年度业绩相关公告，按半年报净利润、业绩快报净利润、业绩预告净利润下限顺序计算，渤海租赁实现扭亏为盈；17股归母净利润实现同比增长，浪潮信息、中国人寿、招商轮船等7股增幅在100%以上。

headlines.title_en: Since July, 25 stocks rated by 5 or more institutions; high-earnings-growth stocks draw concentrated attention
headlines.summary_en: According to statistics, as of July 29, 44 institutions have issued 936 'buy-type' (including buy, add, recommend, strongly recommend, strongly buy) ratings cumulatively since July, covering 546 stocks in total. By stock, 25 stocks have received ratings from 5 or more institutions since July, with Kweichow Moutai, CATL, China Life, and Hengrui Medicine leading with 17, 16, 11, and 10 institutional ratings respectively. By performance, high-profit-growth stocks have garnered concentrated institutional attention. Among these 25 stocks, 19 have released semi-annual performance announcements. Based on the order of semi-annual net profit, performance express net profit, and performance forecast net profit lower limit, Bohai Leasing turned profitable; 17 stocks achieved year-on-year growth in net profit attributable to parent, with Inspur Information, China Life, China Merchants Energy Shipping, and four others seeing growth of over 100%.

headlines.title: 中金：中国钨业龙头有望迎来量价齐升
headlines.summary: 中金公司研报指出，当前AI、高端装备等新兴需求快速增长，中国钨产业链下游、中游等关键环节利润率持续向好。国内钨价在7月下跌企稳后再次出现涨价迹象，海外溢价率也已创下历史新高。中金公司认为中国钨业龙头有望迎来量价齐升，且当前估值水平已具备较大吸引力。

headlines.title_en: CICC: China's tungsten leader may see volume and price surge
headlines.summary_en: CICC research note points out that with rapidly growing demand from emerging sectors like AI and high-end equipment, profit margins in key downstream and midstream segments of China's tungsten supply chain are improving steadily. Domestic tungsten prices have shown signs of rising again after stabilizing in July, while overseas premiums have hit all-time highs. CICC believes China's tungsten leaders are poised for volume and price growth, and current valuations are already quite attractive.
